clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, young orc woman Zankaja waits anxiously for word of her mate, Dogran. He was assigned to duty at the Crossroads, along the dangerous frontier of the Barrens.

Zankaja waits for news of Dogran, her mate, in Orgrimmar. Dogran earned a promotion and went south to bolster the outpost at the Crossroads in the Barrens. The assignment honors a warrior, but the frontier is harsh, with quilboar, centaur, and aggressive beasts. When Dogran failed to send word or return as expected, Zankaja began asking travelers to seek news of him.
